title: Offer
description: A provider's public offer to perform a task at a stated price (the 'task.offer' message body, RFC-0002). The provider's private minimum/reservation price is NEVER part of this object: 'additionalProperties' is false, so only the public 'price' can cross the wire. A leaked reservation field is a schema-validation error by construction.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this offer is for.

price.description: Public offered price. Always >= the provider's private reservation, which is not represented here (RFC-0002 §negotiation).

currency.description: Currency code for 'price', e.g. 'USD'. Demo-scale value; no real funds move.

terms.description: Optional non-price terms (e.g. verification commitment). MUST NOT carry any reservation/minimum-price field.

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
